header.name: Living room V16
header.description: Living room from two photos, estimated sizes in inches. V16: merge of V15 and V10. Restored from V10: window frames on every window, a window on the TV wall (near the far corner, as in the photos), baseboards, door handle, blue and pink fans and the boxed puzzle on the bookcase, the water bottle, dark box, two puzzle sheets and the third wooden chair, plus books in the near unit. The V10 bookcase plants moved to the floor, since the TV console now sits on the far unit.
